7.7.9.4 Notification and Set of the warning indicator status [SWS_Dem_00046] ⌈The Dem module shall provide the API Dem_GetIndica- torStatus that a software component can get information about the calculated in- dicator status.⌋ [SWS_Dem_01361] Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04110, RS_Diag_04204 ⌈If an indicator is activated in multiple modes at the same time, the API Dem_GetIndi- catorStatus shall return the status considering the following priority: • DEM_INDICATOR_BLINK_CONT (highest priority) • DEM_INDICATOR_BLINKING • DEM_INDICATOR_FAST_FLASH • DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH • DEM_INDICATOR_CONTINUOUS • DEM_INDICATOR_SHORT • DEM_INDICATOR_ON_DEMAND • DEM_INDICATOR_OFF (lowest priority) ⌋ Note: The returned indicator status type in [SWS_Dem_01361] is the most natural order of the indicator status in case multiple events trigger the status. At the time this specification was written this is compliant to known legislated requirements as well as to OEMs. AUTOSAR explicitly allows the option to change the order of indicator status according to [SWS_Dem_01361] to fulfil manufacture specific indicator states as well as legislated requirements to come.
